units: label: dust density and error M**-3 (m^-3), altitude Km (km)
south_polar_suitability: not verified; orbital sampling cannot represent every polar surface pixel
limitation: Orbital dust density is not surface dust depth, adhesion, or rover dust hazard. Archive access may fail; retain negative results.

name: Apollo 17 LEAM raw ARCSAV records
units: raw field units pending label; no inferred dust flux
south_polar_suitability: not suitable as south-polar grid; Apollo 17 site only
limitation: LEAM counts must not be equated directly with mobile surface dust concentration. Local historical context only.

name: LADEE NMS derived Ar, He and Ne abundances
units: selected argon label: density and Std P/Cc (particles per cubic centimetre); positions/altitude Kilometers
south_polar_suitability: not verified; orbital observations, not a polar surface pressure raster
limitation: Neutral species abundances are not total surface pressure. Do not derive pressure without an appropriate physical model and required temperatures.

name: Apollo 15 SIDE/CCIG raw records
units: raw fields pending labels and calibration; no pressure conversion applied
south_polar_suitability: not suitable as south-polar grid; Apollo 15 site only
limitation: Raw CCIG observations and separate scanned density plots are not a global pressure raster. Density and pressure must remain distinct.

name: LRO LAMP polar far-ultraviolet GDR maps
measurement_kind: derived radiometry; illumination uses a separate model
representation: PDS IMG polar rasters with detached labels
units: catalog: brightness photons/cm2/s/sr; albedo dimensionless; exposure s
south_polar_suitability: catalog covers 80-90 S; valid coverage and exact product label pending
limitation: Far-UV brightness/albedo are not visible lux, broadband solar power, or the fraction of time sunlit. Exact file access and label still needed.

name: LROC WAC 643 nm Hapke parameter map
measurement_kind: photometric model fit to observed reflectance
units: parameter dependent: single-scattering albedo dimensionless; other units/order must be verified
south_polar_suitability: excluded from south-polar extraction: latitude limited to 70 S-70 N
limitation: Reflective surface properties are not incoming illumination or direct soil strength. Too coarse and outside the south-polar area.

name: Diviner GHRM slope-adjusted-midnight rock abundance
representation: GeoTIFF and PDS IMG spatial products
units: selected PDS label does not declare rock-abundance units; fraction versus percent remains unverified
south_polar_suitability: selected catalog product is 70 S-70 N; excluded from polar test region
limitation: Areal rock abundance is not dust quantity, grain-size distribution, mineral chemistry, or bearing strength. Listing shows approximately 3.3 GB: metadata only in this scout.

name: Apollo 15 LSRP soil mechanics
units: selected label: load Newton, stress Newton/cm^2, penetration depth Centimeter, drum deflection Millimeter
